# Owned invariant carrier and nominal result fixture

An invariant collection input anchors one Object-bounded method formal while
File, String and primitive contexts retain independent original values. Opaque
provider behavior keeps exact collection, file, text and flag identity, closed
unchecked Exceptions metadata, effects, partial writes and late File dispatch.
Four immutable caller routes run 96 fresh JVM cases twice in source and
SDK-provider profiles. Every recovered unit compiles with original metadata;
six wrong programs and six Code-preserving signature controls guard behavior
and scope. Only owned fixtures and standard SDK code execute, with no file I/O.
Use JDK 25; originals use release 8 and recovery uses its reported Java release.
